relations.subject: William Wilson Hunter
relations.evidence: He was educated at the University of Glasgow (BA 1860), Paris and Bonn, acquiring a knowledge of Sanskrit, LL.D.

relations.subject: William Wilson Hunter
relations.evidence: in 1886 he was elected vice-chancellor of the University of Calcutta.

relations.subject: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay
relations.evidence: The Annals of Rural Bengal, which influenced the historical romances of Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.

relations.subject: William Wilson Hunter
relations.evidence: He also compiled A Comparative Dictionary of the Non-Aryan Languages of India, a glossary of dialects based mainly upon the collections of Brian Houghton Hodgson
